definition: depth of the replacement = the chart tier of the first man listed below the unavailable player who is not himself Out or Doubtful in the same official report

sources.charts: each club's own /team/depth-chart page (URL per row); all self-labelled unofficial by the clubs

limits: Club charts are unofficial by the clubs' own label and only 5 of 32 print an as-of date, so a chart may predate a trade or a promotion.
Houston publishes an image only; its rows are UNVERIFIED, not guessed.
A chart is a depth ORDER, not a snap count. The next man up may in practice play fewer snaps than the man behind him.
This is Week 10 only; no history exists, so no replacement-depth effect can be fitted yet (see the correlation page, blank rows).
